body_reference_origin: Mean of M3–M6, per operator. Reference origin is not a measured COM.
point_basis_note: Marker-table coordinate convention uses the observedY-up table and operator-described roll flip. Kept distinct from recorded ROS/TF quaternion basis. Verify with the visual layout.
vertical_offset_status: Illustrative registration to place displayed marker spheres under4mm arm plates; not measured CAD-to-COM translation.
model_origin_centroid_constraint: Markers are centred exactly at body origin. CAD lateral centre is aligned; vertical registration is explicitly provisional.

mesh.detail_note: Fasteners omitted; dense motor/electronic meshes use convex hulls. Frame and propeller outlines retained.

COM_preview_note: Operator estimates COM25mm below actual FC; this display uses the approximate CAD FC bbox centre and unconfirmed vertical registration. Do not use this point as a measured COM for inertia correction.
